window16-bounded-original.field_contract: field API differences expected only when squat agrees with mainline visible-child fields; ERROR parents have no fields
window16-bounded-original.iterator_contract: native preorder; cached variants lazily unpack IDs; attribute walks derive depth from descendant counts; mainline uses its forward cursor
window16-bounded-original.cursor_contract: walk-forward uses bulk cursor attributes; cursor-forward measures native navigation
window16-bounded-original.query_engine: slab NFA and structural plans adapted from ../main
window16-bounded-original.seek_contract: known differences counted but ignored by user request
